Name: Unique Valley
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod is highly experimental.

It shuffles (almost) the entire cast of Stardew Valley, assigning new roles to each character at random.

Age, gender, and datability are maintained by default, and you can place any character on the forbidden list to stop them from being swapped (George is on this list by default).

Under the hood, NPCs are still the original characters, their names and graphics are just swapped. Names in the dialogue and other strings are also swapped (mostly). It really shouldn't break much beyond animations that don't exist on swapped characters. It might, though.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.
